definitions: A thin, pointed piece of metal, wood, or other hard material.
A sharp increase in the something.
A spiky, often brightly coloured, hairstyle.
One of the sharp, pointed projections on the sole of a sports shoe, used to improve grip.
examples: He hammered a spike into the wall.
There was a spike in temperatures yesterday.
Her hair was styled in colourful spikes.
The runner's spikes dug into the track.
